```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r packages}
library(vars)        # load first: avoids the MASS select() conflict
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

select <- dplyr::select   # MASS (loaded with vars) also has a select(); use dplyr's
copper_file <- "fred_copper_2026-10-06.csv"
oil_file    <- "fred_brent_2026-10-06.csv"
```

## Step 1: Commodity prices, quarterly growth

```{r}
read_fred <- function(file, name) {
  read_csv(here("data", "raw", file), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    rename(date = 1, value = 2) |>
    mutate(date = as.Date(date), value = as.numeric(value)) |>
    filter(!is.na(value)) |>
    mutate(date = floor_date(date, "quarter")) |>
    group_by(date) |>
    summarise(price = mean(value), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    filter(n == 3) |>
    transmute(date, !!name := 400 * (log(price) - log(lag(price))))   # annualized quarterly growth
}

comm <- read_fred(copper_file, "copper") |>
  full_join(read_fred(oil_file, "oil"), by = "date") |>
  arrange(date)
range(comm$date)
saveRDS(comm, here("data", "svar", "commodity_growth_q.rds"))
```

## Step 2: VAR with exogenous commodity prices

```{r}
svar_data <- readRDS(here("data", "svar", "svar_data.rds"))

dx <- svar_data |>
  left_join(comm |> mutate(copper_l1 = lag(copper), oil_l1 = lag(oil)), by = "date")
stopifnot(!anyNA(dx))
range(dx$date); nrow(dx)

y <- as.matrix(dx[, c("growth", "infl")])
X <- as.matrix(dx[, c("copper", "oil", "copper_l1", "oil_l1")])

varx <- VAR(y, p = 1, type = "const", exogen = X)
roots(varx)
serial.test(varx, lags.pt = 12, type = "PT.asymptotic")
round(summary(varx)$varresult$infl$coefficients, 3)     # how inflation responds to copper and oil
round(summary(varx)$varresult$growth$coefficients, 3)
```

## Step 3: Quah-Vahey identification of the domestic shocks

```{r}
bqx <- BQ(varx)
s   <- c(sign(bqx$LRIM[1, 1]), sign(bqx$B[2, 2]))
B   <- bqx$B %*% diag(s)
dimnames(B) <- list(c("growth", "infl"), c("noncore", "core"))
s; round(B, 3); round(bqx$LRIM %*% diag(s), 3)
```

## Step 4: Decompose inflation into core, non-core, and commodity contributions

```{r}
A1   <- Acoef(varx)[[1]]
cf   <- sapply(varx$varresult, coef)                    # rows: coefficients, columns: equations
Cx   <- t(cf[colnames(X), ])                            # 2 x 4: effects of the commodity variables
xbar <- colMeans(X)
mu   <- as.numeric(solve(diag(2) - A1, cf["const", ] + Cx %*% xbar))   # long-run means
eps  <- resid(varx) %*% t(solve(B)); colnames(eps) <- c("noncore", "core")
xd   <- sweep(X[-1, , drop = FALSE], 2, xbar)           # commodity deviations from average, aligned with residuals

n <- nrow(eps)
core <- nc <- ext <- matrix(0, n, 2)
for (t in seq_len(n)) {
  prev <- function(m) if (t == 1) c(0, 0) else m[t - 1, ]
  core[t, ] <- A1 %*% prev(core) + B[, "core"]    * eps[t, "core"]
  nc[t, ]   <- A1 %*% prev(nc)   + B[, "noncore"] * eps[t, "noncore"]
  ext[t, ]  <- A1 %*% prev(ext)  + Cx %*% xd[t, ]
}

qvx <- tibble(date          = dx$date[-1],
              infl          = dx$infl[-1],
              core          = mu[2] + core[, 2],
              noncore_part  = nc[, 2],
              external_part = ext[, 2])

# check: should start nonzero and die out
qvx |> mutate(gap = infl - (core + noncore_part + external_part)) |>
  summarise(first_gap = first(gap), fifth_gap = nth(gap, 5), last_gap = last(gap))
saveRDS(qvx, here("data", "svar", "qv_core_external.rds"))

# how variable is each component?
qvx |> summarise(across(c(infl, core, noncore_part, external_part), sd)) |> round(2)

# compare with the baseline SVAR core
base <- readRDS(here("data", "svar", "qv_core.rds")) |> select(date, core_base = core)
qvx |>
  inner_join(base, by = "date") |>
  summarise(cor_cores        = cor(core, core_base),
            cor_hl_external  = cor(core, infl),
            cor_hl_baseline  = cor(core_base, infl),
            smooth_external  = mean(abs(diff(core))),
            smooth_baseline  = mean(abs(diff(core_base)))) |>
  round(3)

p_ext <- qvx |>
  inner_join(base, by = "date") |>
  select(date, Headline = infl, `Core (baseline SVAR)` = core_base,
         `Core (with commodity block)` = core, `Commodity contribution` = external_part) |>
  pivot_longer(-date) |>
  ggplot(aes(date, value, colour = name)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_line() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Inflation (annualized quarterly, %)", colour = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
p_ext
ggsave(here("output", "svar_figures", "qv_core_external.png"), p_ext, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```
